title: Hillary Clinton tells Kimmel she'll get to the bottom of UFOs

tellings.quote: and and and then he asked her the question and that's when she says, "I'm going to get to the bottom of this."

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron recalls that in 2016, Hillary Clinton, then running for US president, appeared on Jimmy Kimmel Live, a late-night TV talk show in Los Angeles. According to Cameron, Kimmel asked her about UFOs and she answered, "I'm going to get to the bottom of this." He tells it as a sign that UFO secrecy had reached the highest levels of politics.
